result:
Both feature screens navigate correctly and back navigation works via the automatic back button. All labels match the spec exactly. The App shell (Section 3) is implemented and verified working on the iOS Simulator, and `ns build ios` succeeds.

Summary of changes:
- `app/components/Home.vue` — title/subtitle, `Health` and `Transcribe` buttons navigating via `$navigateTo`
- `app/components/Health.vue` — status line, disabled `Log 500 Steps`, `Last 7 Days` section with empty state (new)
- `app/components/Transcribe.vue` — status line, disabled `Transcribe Sample`, transcript empty state (new)

Back navigation uses NativeScript's automatic ActionBar back button, no native calls yet per Phase 1 scope.
